mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month preceding the prediction is associated with a short-term decline in equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during high-Fed periods (p > 0.05), or the 5-day return is positive despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4% for two consecutive months, labor market strength is interpreted as supporting corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite sustained unemployment declines below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3% is interpreted as early evidence of wage-price misalignment, which precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% month-on-month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or the CPIAUCSL increase is not followed by negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month average for three consecutive months signals supply-side expansion, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO exceeds 12-month rolling average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or INDPRO does not sustain the expansion for the required duration.

mechanism_narrative: When the 6-week moving average of FEDFUNDS falls below 3%, it indicates a shift toward accommodative policy, which is expected to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the period of lower FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) to below 3.5% triggers a strong labor market signal that, when combined with rising payrolls (PAYEMS), predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 3.5% AND PAYEMS increases in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is not positive or UNRATE does not fall while PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A two consecutive months of declining retail sales (implied via negative HOUST) suggests weakening demand, which is expected to result in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the contraction.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer confidence (implied via negative HOUST) suggest supply-demand imbalance, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month avg AND HOUST < prior month for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Dual contraction in supply and sentiment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative or the dual contraction does not precede positive returns.
